sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Ruflo is an agent meta-harness for Claude Code and Codex. It adds specialised agents, swarm coordination, memory, hooks and an MCP server to your project so your coding assistant can split work across many agents.
sixtySeconds.problem: A single coding agent works one step at a time and forgets between sessions. Ruflo gives it a team of specialised agents, shared vector memory, background workers and a console to monitor and replay runs.
whoFor: Claude Code users who want multi-agent swarms
Codex and other MCP client users
Developers automating reviews, tests and refactors
Teams wanting a console to monitor agent cost and runs
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it to give Claude Code a large, ready-made set of agents, skills and swarm tools. It adds many files to your project, so try the plugin route first if you want something lighter.
requirements: Claude Code (2.1.287+ for plugins), Codex or another MCP client

overview: Running npx ruflo@latest init adds ruflo's agents, hooks, memory and MCP server to your project, and Claude Code picks them up on its next start. You then ask Claude Code to use a ruflo swarm for a real task, such as reviewing the repo and writing tests for its riskiest module.

There are two install paths. The CLI install gives the full loop (the README lists 98 agents, 60+ commands, 30 skills, an MCP server, hooks and a daemon) and writes .claude/, .claude-flow/ and CLAUDE.md into your project. The Claude Code plugin route adds core tools, the console and mods with no files in your workspace.

Mission Control, opened with /ruflo, tracks workflows, agents, models, token use and cost, lets you inspect and replay runs, and lets you choose what Claude may do in the console. Other capabilities include swarm topologies, vector memory, background workers, multi-provider routing and a plugin marketplace.

/plugin install ruflo-console@ruflo

/reload-plugins
/ruflo

troubleshooting.solution: Use npx ruflo@latest init wizard, which works in PowerShell and cmd.

troubleshooting.problem: Claude Code doesn't show ruflo tools
troubleshooting.solution: Restart Claude Code after init; plugins need version 2.1.287 or later.

troubleshooting.problem: /ruflo console doesn't open after a CLI init
troubleshooting.solution: Run npx ruflo init and restart Claude Code before opening /ruflo.
